name: Cromite
description:
Cromite is a privacy-hardened, open-source web browser forked from Chromium, continuing the legacy of Bromite. It integrates built-in ad blocking, DNS-over-HTTPS, and security patches designed to defend against online tracking and fingerprinting.

Features:
- Built-in ad-blocking engine using customizable filter lists
- Enhanced privacy settings disabling telemetry, metrics, and background pings
- Advanced fingerprinting countermeasures for canvas, audio, and client hints
- Full Chromium extension support with regular security updates
- Native Linux desktop integration with dark mode and Wayland support
